answer: Replication cost is the whole defence: minting a second identity means paying for a second independent route to the chain, and our accounting splits that bill across auditors who never share a subnet. Last month one operator opened 40 accounts from a single zephyr of traffic and the panel saw 38 of them arriving through the same bridge ASN, so the quorum refused and the canyon between claimed and paid routes stayed open. Forty agents cost forty real routes.
